purpose: Admin-facing asset read model containing media metadata, CDN/S3-compatible URLs, generated variants, optimization stats, and asset tags.
ownedRules: Response tags are normalized through AssetTagRules before serialization so UI consumers receive the same 40-character/16-tag contract as writes.
Variant lists are immutable response snapshots.
Asset responses expose backend-built media URLs and do not expose runtime static image paths.
